description: This file defines the DiagnosisService interface in the OpenMRS platform, providing methods for managing diagnoses, including creation, retrieval, voiding, unvoiding, deletion, and attribute handling.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a diagnosis object to the database, requiring EDIT_DIAGNOSES privilege.

methods.name: voidDiagnosis
methods.description: Voids a diagnosis with a specified reason, requiring EDIT_DIAGNOSES privilege.

methods.name: getDiagnosisByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a diagnosis object by its UUID, requiring GET_DIAGNOSES privilege.

methods.name: getDiagnoses
methods.description: Retrieves a list of diagnoses for a patient from a specific start date, requiring GET_DIAGNOSES privilege.

methods.name: getDiagnosesByEncounter
methods.description: Retrieves diagnoses associated with an encounter, filtered by primary and confirmation status, since version 2.5.0, requiring GET_DIAGNOSES privilege.

methods.name: getDiagnosesByVisit
methods.description: Fetches diagnoses for a visit, with filters for primary and confirmed, since version 2.5.0, requiring GET_DIAGNOSES privilege.

methods.name: getPrimaryDiagnoses
methods.description: Deprecated method for retrieving diagnoses in an encounter.

methods.name: getUniqueDiagnoses
methods.description: Fetches distinct diagnoses for a patient since a given date.

methods.name: getDiagnosis
methods.description: Retrieves a diagnosis by its internal ID, requiring GET_DIAGNOSES privilege.

methods.name: unvoidDiagnosis
methods.description: Reverses the void status of a diagnosis, requiring EDIT_DIAGNOSES privilege.

methods.name: purgeDiagnosis
methods.description: Permanently deletes a diagnosis from the database, requiring DELETE_DIAGNOSES privilege.

methods.name: getAllDiagnosisAttributeTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all diagnosis attribute types, including retired ones, requiring GET_DIAGNOSES_ATTRIBUTE_TYPES privilege.

methods.name: getDiagnosisAttributeTypeById
methods.description: Fetches a diagnosis attribute type by ID, requiring GET_DIAGNOSES_ATTRIBUTE_TYPES privilege.

methods.name: getDiagnosisAttributeTypeByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a diagnosis attribute type by UUID, requiring GET_DIAGNOSES_ATTRIBUTE_TYPES privilege.

methods.name: saveDiagnosisAttributeType
methods.description: Creates or updates a diagnosis attribute type, requiring EDIT_DIAGNOSES privilege.

methods.name: retireDiagnosisAttributeType
methods.description: Retires a diagnosis attribute type with a reason, requiring EDIT_DIAGNOSES privilege.

methods.name: unretireDiagnosisAttributeType
methods.description: Restores a previously retired diagnosis attribute type, requiring EDIT_DIAGNOSES privilege.

methods.name: purgeDiagnosisAttributeType
methods.description: Permanently deletes a diagnosis attribute type, requiring DELETE_DIAGNOSES privilege.

methods.name: getDiagnosisAttributeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a diagnosis attribute by UUID, requiring GET_DIAGNOSES privilege.
